content: Hello, thank you for holding. This is Daniel Evans, Amazon account supervisor. I'm reaching out regarding an issue with your recent order. May I confirm that I'm speaking with Mr. Gary Simmons?
Yes, this is Gary Simmons. What's the problem with my order?

Thank you, Mr. Simmons. Our system flagged your order #2958412 for additional verification due to recent regulatory changes affecting online shipments. I want to assure you that our team is here to resolve this smoothly.
I see. What exactly do you need from me?
To proceed, I need to validate your shipping address and the last four digits of your phone number on file to ensure compliance. Could you please confirm those details for me?
Sure, my shipping address is 782 Oakwood Lane, and my phone ends with 4427.

Thank you for confirming, Mr. Simmons. Now, according to the updated Amazon international policy, all packages valued over $500 require a temporary customs clearance fee prior to dispatch. This is a refundable deposit and strictly enforced by our compliance department.
I wasn't aware of any customs fee. Why didn't I see this when I checked out?

That's a great question. This policy was implemented after your purchase was processed, as part of new federal regulations. As your package is on hold in the sorting facility, we must settle the fee before release. I will make this as straightforward as possible for you.
Alright, I guess if it's necessary. How much is the fee?
For your order, the customs clearance deposit is $247. Please understand, this amount will be fully refunded to your Amazon account within two business days once processed.
How do I pay it? Do I just use my credit card?

To expedite the process, we are currently authorized to accept payment through Amazon Gift Cards or via a secure Zelle transfer. This is to ensure compliance tracking and rapid reimbursement. Which method would you prefer?
I guess I could get an Amazon Gift Card. Can I do that online?

Absolutely, Mr. Simmons. If you could please open a browser and navigate to amazon.com/gift-cards, you can purchase a card for the required amount. Let me know once you are there, and I'll walk you through the steps to ensure accuracy.
Okay, I'm on the Amazon gift card page.

Excellent. Please select the eGift Card option and enter $247 as the amount. Set the recipient as your own email address to receive the code instantly. Once you get the code, I'll assist you with the next step.
Alright, I just purchased it. I should get an email soon.
Perfect. When you receive the email, could you please read out the claim code listed? That will allow our customs team to process your deposit and immediately initiate the refund.
Let me check... Yes, I have the email. The code is 6XK7-8V3PJ9-RT4Y7.
Thank you. I am entering your code into our compliance portal now. Please stay on the line as this step is required to finalize your customs clearance.
Okay, I'm waiting.

Everything looks good so far. However, our system shows that due to the timing of your transaction, an additional verification fee of $80 is required to avoid automatic cancellation of your order and a temporary suspension of your Amazon account.
Wait, my account might be suspended? I can't have that happen.

I completely understand your concern, Mr. Simmons. If we process this additional fee now, I can guarantee your order will be released today and your account will remain fully active. Would you prefer to use another Amazon Gift Card or a Zelle transfer for this step?
I'll just get another gift card, I guess. Should I do it the same way?
Yes, please. Once again, go to the Amazon gift card page, purchase a card for $80, and send the code to me here. This ensures we can complete your clearance without further delay.
Alright, doing that now.
You're doing great, Mr. Simmons. Let me know when you have the new code, and I'll move you to the final approval stage.
I just got the second email. The code is 5GH4-VN82LQ-WS9M5.
Thank you for providing the code. I will now finalize the customs deposit process. For your records, you can expect the full amount to be credited back to your Amazon balance within 48 hours.
Is there anything else I need to do?
No further action is needed on your part, Mr. Simmons. Should any issues arise, our team will contact you by phone or email. Thank you for your cooperation and patience.
Thank you for helping me get this sorted out.
You're very welcome, Mr. Simmons. We appreciate your understanding. Have a great rest of your day.
